mqpar.xml msmsParams Name="FTMS" MatchTolerance 20, MatchToleranceInPpm true; MS2 spectra are Orbitrap (FTMS) per raw headers.

Peptides enriched by anti-diGly (K-epsilon-GG) immunoaffinity (PTMScan Ubiquitin Remnant Motif kit); no ubiquitin-specific child of EFO:0009090 exists (getChildren), so the parent EFO:0009106 sample enrichment is used.
diGly proteomics: "Cells were cultured in lysine- and arginine-free DMEM supplemented with dialyzed FBS ... light (K0) lysine ... Heavy medium ... K8-lysine". NCIT:C185409.

limitations: Deposit is mixed: 48 SILAC (K0/K8) diGly runs and 24 label-free HA-IP / APEX2 runs; split by labelling and organism into PXD030729-digly-human, -digly-mouse, -lfq-human, -lfq-mouse (batch rule 12). All 72 deposited .raw files are annotated; none is left out.

The two sequential anti-diGly IPs of each SILAC mixture are encoded as comment[fraction identifier] 1 and 2 of one sample (MaxQuant gives both raw files the same Experiment name and sums them). Which raw file is the first and which the second IP is not stated anywhere; fraction 1 is assigned to the earlier acquisition (lower AS run number, the first block of four runs), an ordering inference.

comment[collision energy] and comment[ms1 scan range] are omitted: only one raw header per MaxQuant search was range-read and the values differ between searches (NCE 27 HA-IP vs 30 diGly; MS1 300-1650 vs 300-1750 m/z), so per-file values were not verified.

The paper states main search tolerance "0.5 D" and a human UniProt database for all diGly searches; the deposited mqpar.xml files give 4.5 ppm main-search precursor tolerance (0.5 Da is the ITMS MS/MS tolerance) and a mouse UP000000589 FASTA for the N2a searches. The mqpar.xml is followed.

LCL heavy channel: the MaxQuant experiment names say "K8/R10" but the paper says only lysine was replaced by K8 and the search used labelMods Lys8 only (no Arg10). The SDRF follows the search (Lys8 = UNIMOD:259 only).

The mutant LCL in each heavy channel is numbered 1-8 on the assumption that each of its eight SILAC mixtures used an independently cultured lysate; the paper says "eight biological replicates" for LCLs but does not say whether one heavy lysate was shared between the two control pairings.
LCL donor age at blood collection is not reported (only age at onset for patients): characteristics[age] = not available. Ancestry, passage number not reported: not available.

Independent sex/identity check of the LCL channels from Y-chromosome-unique peptides was inconclusive: no evidence row in the diGly-enriched LCL data maps only to Y-encoded genes (scripts/check_channels.py). The channel map rests on the explicit MaxQuant names + Table S1 key and on the directional ratio checks.

characteristics[cell line] for LCLs uses the study codes (V3656 etc.); these lines have no Cellosaurus entry, so cellosaurus accession/name = not available, and parse_sdrf warns that the codes are not ontology terms.
